items.how: Privacy policy; data processing records; breach log.
items.ref: DPDP Act 2023 and Rules (phased commencement); IT Act 2000 s.43A
steps: Obtain privacy policy and data processing records
Check consent and breach handling against provisions in force
items.text: Personal data handling, consent, breach reporting and security practices meet the provisions in force.
SOFTEX forms filed for software exports; export proceeds realised within the permitted time.

steps: Obtain STPI / SEZ approval and APR
items.text: STPI or SEZ unit conditions met: annual performance report, net foreign exchange positive, bond / LUT valid.
Eligibility and computation of SEZ deduction verified.
